'''Project Harvest''' was a joint project of the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] and [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It had been running in various forms for decades by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and was mainly concerned with [[Alien/Legends|alien]] genetic study and reformatting. [[Eckard Lokin]] was among those involved in the project, though after a strike of conscience, he resigned and took his research with him. However, a copy of his research remained in the hands of the Imperial Science Bureau and eventually led to [[Project Protean]]. [[Watcher X]] was aware of the project's activities and at some point leaked them to the [[Cipher Agent|Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]].
